name: md-to-docx-local
description: Standalone local Markdown to DOCX converter.

scripts.build: pnpm run bundle && pkg build/md-to-docx.cjs --targets node20-linux-x64 --no-bytecode --public --output dist/md-to-docx-linux-x64
scripts.check: node --check src/cli.cjs && node --check scripts/build-release.mjs && node --check release.mjs
